posts.quote:
Climb the mountains
and get their good tidings.
Nature’s peace will flow into you
as sunshine flows into trees.
posts.author: John Muir

posts.quote:
A lake is the landscape’s most
beautiful and expressive feature.
posts.author: Henry David Thoreau

posts.quote:
In the woods,
we return to reason and faith.
posts.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson

posts.quote:
Heaven is under our feet
as well as over our heads.
posts.author: Henry David Thoreau

posts.quote:
Thousands of tired, nerve-shaken,
over-civilized people
are beginning to find out
that going to the mountains
is going home
posts.author: John Muir

posts.quote:
In the woods too,
a man casts off his years,
as the snake his slough,
and at what period soever of life,
is always a child.
posts.author: Ralph Waldo Emerson
John Muir
